name: Ad Spend Review
summary: Find campaign costs and results that need a closer look.

name: Bot Porter
summary: Move the useful instructions for a Bot into a different app without pretending everything transfers.

name: Bug Examiner
summary: Reproduce a reported software problem and show exactly what failed.

name: Call Coach
summary: Help a salesperson improve one specific part of a recorded call.

name: Campaign Builder
summary: Turn approved messages into a small campaign that is ready for a person to review.

name: Change Reviewer
summary: Check whether a proposed software change fixes the problem without breaking something else.

name: Clip Planner
summary: Find useful short clips in a recording without changing what the speaker meant.

name: Competitor Brief
summary: Show what changed in a short list of competing products.

name: Deal Reviewer
summary: Check a sales opportunity against the team's stated requirements.

name: Habit Coach
summary: Fit a chosen everyday habit into the time you have.

name: Lead Qualifier
summary: Find which approved prospects fit the offer and which should be left alone.

name: Outreach Coordinator
summary: Prepare a small, accurate batch of outreach and prevent duplicate contact.

name: Pipeline Review
summary: Find stalled opportunities and unreliable numbers in a sales pipeline.

name: Pitch Coach
summary: Find the weak claims and unanswered questions in a pitch.

name: Search Presence
summary: Check how a business appears in a defined set of searches and AI answers.

name: Skill Builder
summary: Turn a successful repeated task into reusable instructions with a checkable result.

name: Subscription Review
summary: Find software subscriptions worth checking before the next renewal.

name: Visual Producer
summary: Prepare useful thumbnails and still images for an approved piece of content.
